training_ablation.findings: Parity by construction eliminates call-put inconsistency exactly and improves most validation RMSEs at matched update counts while reducing price-bound violation frequency; measured exceptions (slightly worse stress Rho, small negative-Gamma frequency increase) are listed in the corrected report. Concentrated near-expiry/near-strike sampling roughly halves target-region Gamma and Theta error at a broad price/Delta accuracy cost. Bound-violation penalties reduce their targeted violations but only at an accuracy cost; no penalty arm both removes violations and keeps accuracy acceptable.
training_ablation.sampling_normalization_caveat: The previous sampling results changed sampling and normalization jointly; the corrected study with shared normalization scales is results/deeponet/sampling_correction/.

parity_refinement.verdict: Refined parity improves 6 of 6 validation RMSEs versus refined control at matched parents, procedure and seeds (price -27.7%) and enforces exact call-put consistency by construction; the corrected audit verifies every saved identity. Financial constraint violations (stress negative-Gamma frequency 13.88% -> 15.19%, price bounds 12.08% -> 13.41%) and limited seed coverage (3 seeds) remain material limitations: parity showed ~17x lower validation price SD across these seeds without establishing general seed robustness. Supports parity as the strongest candidate; the registered primary remains unchanged pending an explicit selection decision.
